title: Protesters condemn US policies as ASEAN summit begins in Manila
html:
Protesters condemn US policies as ASEAN summit begins in Manila

Southeast Asian leaders arriving in the Philippines for the ASEAN summit have been met with protests over how expensive basic commodities have become. There is also anger over the US-led AI supply chain initiative called Pax Silica, as Al Jazeera’s Barnaby Lo reports.
summary: Southeast Asian leaders arriving in the Philippines for the ASEAN summit have been met with protests.
